subject: Renewal & capacity addendum — redlines for logs retention and SLA
messages:
From: Ezra Park <ezra@stellaris.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Gretchen Li <gretchen@stellaris.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — addendum questions

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week. We are preparing our renewal paperwork and want to increase committed throughput and add an audit/logs retention clause. High level requests:

- Seats/throughput: increase dedicated concurrency from 200 r/s to 300 r/s starting on renewal term.
- Logs retention: need 13 months of retained audit logs (searchable exportable) for compliance.
- SLA: a narrow exception for scheduled batch processing latency (we run nightly bulk requests) — want a guaranteed median within 2x of standard SLA for batch windows.

Attached is our Renewal_Request PDF with the order quantities and internal PO. Can you confirm how this maps to the order form and whether Redwood can accept 13 months for logs? Also please share any redlines to the MSA that would be required.

Appreciate a quick read; our procurement team wants to target signature by May 20.

Thanks,
Ezra Park
Head of Platform Ops
Stellaris AI

Attachment: Stellaris_Renewal_Request.pdf (1 page)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ezra Park <ezra@stellaris.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — addendum questions

Hi Ezra — thanks for the note and the attachment. Good news: we can support the capacity bump and we have a clear path for the logs retention request. Next steps I propose:

1) Redwood will provide an Addendum (Order Form + Addendum) that:
   - Reflects the throughput/seat increases you outlined, pro-rated to the renewal date.
   - Includes a logs retention clause specifying 13 months with export rights.
2) Legal will prepare a redline to the MSA for the logs/SLA language; I CC'd Marcus for that.
3) I'll share a proposed addendum redline by EOD tomorrow (May 16) and then we can iterate.

Quick clarifications: is the billing contact for the renewal still procurement@stellaris.ai and do you want annual billing or monthly? Also, is the requested batch SLA exception only for nightly windows (00:00–04:00 PT)?

If those answers are confirmed I will push the doc to DocuSign and loop in finance.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_proposed_addendum_redline.docx (summary redline)

From: Gretchen Li <gretchen@stellaris.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Ezra Park <ezra@stellaris.ai>, procurement@stellaris.ai
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — addendum questions

Thanks Mina — quick answers inline:

- Billing contact: procurement@stellaris.ai (confirmed).
- Billing cadence: annual preferred.
- Batch SLA window: yes, only nightly 00:00–04:00 PT. We still need a firm commitment that if batch latency degrades beyond the exception we can submit a remediation ticket and receive service credits.

I've attached our internal markup showing the places we need explicit export rights for logs and a slightly adjusted definition of "Audit Logs" (see page 2).

Gretchen
Head of Procurement
Stellaris AI

Attachment: stellaris_markups.pdf (annotated PDF, 2 pages)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Gretchen Li <gretchen@stellaris.ai>, Ezra Park <ezra@stellaris.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 11:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — addendum questions

Hi all — looping in from Legal with a proposed set of edits. Key points from our side:

- Logs retention: we can accept 13 months retention for "Audit Logs" provided Stellaris has the ability to export logs on demand in a standard format (JSON/CSV) and we retain the right to truncate logs under security incident protocols. Proposed clause: "Redwood will retain Audit Logs for thirteen (13) months and provide Stellaris with export capabilities upon reasonable request."
- SLA exception: we can add a batch-window carveout (00:00–04:00 PT) with the following condition: if median latency during the batch window exceeds 2x the standard SLA for more than 3 consecutive nights, Redwood will apply a remediation plan and may provide service credits as agreed in Schedule B.
- MSA cross-reference: we propose adding an addendum that amends Sections 3.2 (Service Levels) and 7.5 (Data Retention). I attached a tracked redline.

We can accept these changes as limited amendments to the MSA; the only remaining point for us is the exact wording around export frequency and the PO threshold for activating the throughput guarantee. I'd like the procurement contact to confirm the expected monthly peak token volume so Sales Ops (Rishi) can verify the sizing.

I'll attach the full tracked redline for review. If this looks OK from Stellaris we can push to DocuSign next business day.

Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: legal_redline_20280516.docx (tracked changes)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Gretchen Li <gretchen@stellaris.ai>, Ezra Park <ezra@stellaris.ai>, procurement@stellaris.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity addendum — redlines for logs retention and SLA

Gretchen/Ezra — thanks for the quick turn. Marcus's language looks good to us. Two small asks before we send to DocuSign:

1) Can procurement confirm estimated peak token volume month-over-month (or a conservative threshold) so Rishi can lock the throughput guarantee?
2) Please confirm acceptance of the proposed export frequency: "upon reasonable request (no more than once per 30 days without additional fees)".

If we get those confirmations today we'll upload the addendum to DocuSign and route to your signer (Gretchen/Ezra). Targeting countersign by COB Monday, May 22 to avoid any lapse.

DocuSign link (will be live when I upload): https://www.docusign.net/recipient/sign?token=ABCD1234-stellaris
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/67891/DEAL-2028-0421

Thanks — Mina
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_proposed_addendum_redline.docx (finalized for upload)

From: Ezra Park <ezra@stellaris.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Gretchen Li <gretchen@stellaris.ai>
Cc: procurement@stellaris.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity addendum — redlines for logs retention and SLA

Mina — confirmed. Procurement accepts the export clause as stated (once per 30 days without additional fees). Estimated conservative peak token volume for sizing: 1.8B tokens/month; will provide a monthly breakdown in a separate spreadsheet.

We signed and uploaded the countersigned addendum; attaching the signed PDF. Please have finance send the annual invoice to procurement@stellaris.ai.

Ezra Park
Head of Platform Ops
Stellaris AI

Attachment: stellaris_signed_addendum.pdf (signed addendum, 3 pages)
